name: release_train_github_app_config_20261023
comment: ANCHOR: RELEASE_TRAIN_GITHUB_APP_CONFIG_20261023 — decision D2: the operator-run helper
scripts/ops/release_train_github_app_config.py discovers the App installation for the repository owner
(GET /app/installations, RS256 JWT from GitHubAppTokenMinter.jwt), proves access with one narrowed installation
token that is dropped (GitHubAppTokenMinter.mint + GET /installation/repositories) and writes github-app.json
atomically, mode 600, archiving a differing old file. Refuses a wrong owner, an ambiguous or suspended
installation, a token that cannot see the repo, a key not mode 600 and a symlinked output. --dry-run writes
nothing. No key, JWT or token in stdout/stderr. Hermetic: throwaway RSA key in tmp_path, fake HTTP layer.
